title: Accept test results from a remote runner through a host-qualified admission contract
outcome: Accept test results from a remote runner through a host-qualified admission contract
acceptance: A remote test result is admitted only as TermAl's K3 remote_verification_record_v1 completion: admission checks the coordinating store's current claim, fence and named root for the item and the exact commit and tree, keeps committed_input and landing_gate uses distinct, and refuses on any mismatch

Remote results stay distinct from local ones in the stored record and in show output: the evidence is attributed to the executing host, nothing implies the coordinating host ran the checks, and no local registered host run is fabricated for it
A remote result whose claim, fence, root, commit or tree doesn't match the current association is refused by name with no write, and an unadmitted remote run remains observable without credit
Existing local registered verification, its tests and its stored records are unchanged
The contract is agreed with TermAl's coordinator against K3's final contract and TermAl w-5e2f3fba987a's reconciled design, and the shipped docs describe it
disposal_reason: Duplicate, filed by me on 11-03 without checking. w-180d6f507470 (rev 7, ready, prerequisite B w-da8c79e5d5ab completed) already holds the agreed remote_verification_record_v1 contract, and its acceptance covers everything here: origin kept distinct, no fabricated local run, named reasons with no write, local behaviour unchanged. The live admission work continues there.
